fields.System.Title: INV-703 — Report adjustments by reason and user
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want to see adjustment volume broken down by reason and by
person, so that I can find the broken process rather than keep correcting its output.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then I get adjustment counts and quantities grouped by reason
  • code.
  • - Given the same range, then I can also group by user and by zone.
  • - Given the report, then it shows a trend over time, not just a current total.
  • - Given an outlier — one reason, user, or zone far above the rest — then it is visible
  • without manual analysis.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | adjustment, stock_movement |
| Risks | Adjustment used to hide process problems ([doc 05 WF 13](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
